details.description: Phind-CodeLlama-34B-v2 is a code-generation model released by Phind in 2023, fine-tuned from Meta's CodeLlama-34B and building on Phind's own earlier Phind-CodeLlama-34B-v1. Phind trained it on about 1.5 billion tokens of high-quality programming problems and solutions, formatted as instruction-answer pairs rather than raw code completions, and instruction-tuned it in the Alpaca/Vicuna format so it is easier to prompt than the v1 model. It supports Python, C/C++, TypeScript, Java, and other languages.
advantages: Scores 73.8% pass@1 on HumanEval, per Phind's own model card.
Trained on about 1.5 billion tokens of high-quality programming problems and solutions across multiple languages (Python, C/C++, TypeScript, Java, and more), per the model card.
Instruction-tuned in the Alpaca/Vicuna format, which Phind states makes it much easier to use than the earlier v1 model.
disadvantages: Phind states the model 'has undergone very limited testing' and recommends additional safety testing before any real-world deployment.
Licensed under the Llama 2 license, per the model card, so use is subject to Meta's Llama 2 terms rather than a fully permissive license.
use_cases: Code generation and completion across multiple programming languages (Python, C/C++, TypeScript, Java, and more).
Instruction-following coding assistance, given its Alpaca/Vicuna-style instruction tuning.

notes: Catalog facts list a 16,384-token max input/output for this model, but Phind's own model card states a 4096-token sequence length used in training (CodeLlama-34B base); kept the catalog's facts as instructed and flag the discrepancy here rather than in the description. Found no page indicating a public replacement newer than v2 on Phind's own pages.
